name: scirooplot

about.summary: ROOT-based C++ and Python framework to define, organize and generate plots
ROOT-based C++ and Python framework to define, organize and generate plots

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "4.0.0"

package:
  name: scirooplot
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/SciRooPlot/SciRooPlot/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 6c7165854f8720c12a915be74499ab4120077b5753b309e91b0de44deaa22f20

build:
  number: 0
  skip:
    - win
  script:
    - cmake -S . -B build ${CMAKE_ARGS}
    - cmake --build build --parallel ${CPU_COUNT}
    - cmake --install build

requirements:
  build:
    - cmake >=3.27
    - make
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
  host:
    - root_base
    - libboost-devel
    - fmt
    - pybind11 >=2.9
    - python
  run:
    - python
  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage('scirooplot', upper_bound='x.x') }}

tests:
  - script:
      - srp info
  - python:
      imports:
        - SciRooPlot
      pip_check: true
  - package_contents:
      include:
        - SciRooPlot/Plot.h
        - SciRooPlot/PlotManager.h
        - SciRooPlot/PanelLayout.h
        - SciRooPlot/Logger.h
      lib:
        - SciRooPlot

about:
  summary: ROOT-based C++ and Python framework to define, organize and generate plots
  license: GPL-3.0-or-later
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/SciRooPlot/SciRooPlot
  repository: https://github.com/SciRooPlot/SciRooPlot
  documentation: https://scirooplot.github.io/SciRooPlot/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - mario-krueger
